quotes.text: we need to lead in AI, we need to win in AI. We can lead and we can win in AI, but to do that we need to get overly burdensome, truly not-focused-on-environment regulations out of the way so capital will flow and things will be built. We need some simplification with permitting. We need to make FERC move more efficiently.

We know now, without a doubt, that terrorist organizations have already integrated generative AI into their operations. [...] using it to produce highly convincing propaganda, making it much easier for terrorist groups to recruit, radicalize, and carry out attacks on the U.S. homeland.
